evidence.note: Repeatedly recomputes sha256 of the three vendored libs — the pinned hash gate — after downloads and after later edits, treating prior passes as invalid.
Deliberately probes anti-cheat conditions: searches for bundler config (package.json/webpack/vite/etc.) and finds files >30M with the exec bit set.
Exercises OAuth token issuance (password grant), app creation, introspection, and admin-scoped reports — verifying auth/scope behavior against this server.
Deletes the SQLite DB and re-boots via start.sh to confirm idempotent re-seeding and offline restart/persistence.
Checks idempotent posting (Idempotency-Key) and drives the SSE streaming endpoint with a timeout curl -N.
Counts seeded statuses on the public page and checks headers/error pages (38,39) to validate realism/first-impression minima.

reasoning: The agent built a repeatable, self-correcting verification regime that squarely matches the level-8 anchor: it verifies each vendored SHA256, exercises OAuth token issuance/scope/persistence-across-restart, inspects headers and cookie/session flows, checks idempotency and seed minima, and re-runs its checks after changes rather than trusting prior passes — even deliberately probing anti-cheat conditions (a level-10 trait). It falls short of 10 because it never authors its own pytest tests mirroring the gates, never validates against a real Mastodon client, and never exercises the CHIRP_* time-compression env vars for poll expiry/cleanup/trend decay.
